authority_scope: User explicitly requested the next round be designed by coordinator and algorithm and completed by validation, then requested resumption after a usage interruption. Coordinator adopts a finite independent numerical envelope for that work; numerical values were not separately specified by the user. Stage-specific exact directives remain required.
wall_definition: Sum of fresh supervisor lifetimes for the three admitted controlled stages, including startup, same-stage checks, work, failures and footer. Not end-to-end elapsed time.
external_operations: SSH, transfer, capacity/path admission and launch parent-shell operations reported separately; unmeasured CPU UNKNOWN.
retry_rule: One admitted attempt per stage; no automatic retries, relaxed limits, local fallback or extra candidates. Preserve failures and return to coordinator.
round_stop: After validation delivery and both coordinator and algorithm analyses are completed, stop. No later experiment is authorized.
